name: RecBench-MD
description: RecBench-MD is a comprehensive benchmark to assess recommendation capabilities of foundation models across multiple datasets and domains, including e-commerce, entertainment, and social media. It evaluates zero-resource, multi-dataset, and multi-domain recommendation performance.
reputation: A niche but increasingly cited benchmark in recommendation research for evaluating foundation models across multiple domains and data regimes.
notes: Evaluates 19 foundation models on 15 datasets spanning 10 domains; highlights benefits of in-domain fine-tuning and multi-domain training.
